data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 冥界圣诞的来访·「姐姐的东西，本女神先看看」
data.description: 【冥界·圣诞夜】以「慰问妹妹」之名，伊什塔尔拎着一大袋圣诞礼物踏进了冥界的雪原。她把包装精美的盒子塞到你手里，红瞳别向一边——「给、给你的。人类世界流行这个……本女神只是入乡随俗！啊，艾蕾要是问起来，就说是一半的一半，分她的那半另算！」
data.action: 礼物袋放在脚边，双手递出包装好的礼盒，红瞳别向一边
data.lighting: 冥界幽蓝雪光与礼物缎带的暖金
data.camera: medium shot, snowfield gift, blue-gold contrast, tsundere mood
data.promptProse: On the snowy underworld plain, Ishtar offers a neatly wrapped Christmas box with both gloved hands while looking bashfully to the side. The larger sack of presents stands beside her boots, leaving her hands free for the gift. A warm white coat, red scarf and long trousers replace her summer street clothes; The star-shaped hairpin remains above her dark hair. Blue snowlight catches the wrapping. Frame the complete handover pose and grounded gift sack, with no readable labels or lettering.
